title: Lo Siento (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar warm baritone male vocal 98bpm upright bass brushed snare quiet character portrait true story grief family father Spanish bilingual unhurried
lyrics:
[Intro - piano bar, quiet and respectful]
June 2025.
A friend died.
Corey sent the link.
Chas replied in Spanish.

[Verse 1]
Kevin Sanders
Thirty-one years old
E-scooter rider
East Fremantle
Remembered as a remarkable man
With a free spirit
That's what the article said
Corey sent it to his dad
And Chas replied
Two words
In Spanish
Lo siento

[Verse 2]
Chas McIvor
Big tough bricklayer
Who corrects grammar at the Swan River
Who calls his kids on Christmas morning
Who sends Happy Birthday with the exclamation marks
Who texts in capitals sometimes
When the feeling is big enough
Replied to his child's grief
In Spanish
Lo siento
Two words
The right ones

[Chorus]
Lo siento
Chas said it
Lo siento
I am sorry
Lo siento
In Spanish
To his child
Lo siento
For the friend who died
At thirty-one
E-scooter
East Fremantle
Free spirit
Lo siento
Chas knows how to say it right

[Bridge - spoken, quiet and precise]
Corey replied: Gracias Papá.
Dad.
In Spanish.
Two words back.
The whole conversation was four words.
Lo siento.
Gracias Papá.
That was the grief handled.
That was the comfort given.
Four words.
Two languages.
One family.

[Verse 3]
Chas doesn't explain
Why he switched to Spanish
He just did
Because sometimes
The language you choose
Is the gentlest one available
And Lo siento carries something
That I'm sorry sometimes doesn't
And Chas knows that
He just said it
The right way

[Chorus reprise]
Lo siento
Gracias Papá
Lo siento
The right words
In the right language
At the right time
That's Chas McIvor
Lo siento

[Outro - piano alone, warm and settled]
Kevin Sanders
Thirty-one
Free spirit
Remarkable man
Lo siento
Chas McIvor
Still the one who knows
What to say
And how
